## Checks

- [ ] `python3 validate-skills.py` passes
- [ ] The skill states the least it needs to run, and nothing is a prerequisite
- [ ] The failure it prevents is named
- [ ] It ships an asset, or there is a reason it does not
- [ ] Claims are separated from verification
- [ ] Worked examples use an invented company, or describe a product rather than naming it
- [ ] No real customer, employer or personal names
- [ ] README updated, if this adds or removes a skill
